description: This file defines a struct called HashRing used for consistent hashing of QueueId objects within the Orleans streaming system. The struct manages a ring of QueueIds, provides methods to retrieve all members, calculate responsible QueueIds based on hash codes, and produces a string representation of the ring.

classes.name: HashRing
classes.description: Internal readonly struct implementing consistent hashing logic for QueueIds in Orleans streams.

methods.name: HashRing
methods.description: Constructor that sorts a given array of QueueIds to create the ring.

methods.name: GetAllRingMembers
methods.description: Returns all QueueIds in the ring.

methods.name: CalculateResponsible
methods.description: Calculates which QueueId is responsible for a given hash code using binary search on the ring.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of all QueueIds in the ring.
